description: D1: boss_engaged for enemy.frostbound (he wakes: a blow, or a giant out on the Rimeglass's ice) switches to Harrok's set (music.boss_harrok: the giants' duel; the Frostbound has no set of his own - the world's sound cap, decision D1-8), after its intro stinger; boss_defeated plays the victory stinger, and an escape (boss_disengaged left) returns the music to the zone.
